This is a 6-month, in-person opportunity in San Francisco.

About Engramme

Engramme is a Frontier AI lab spun out of Harvard focusing on AI x Human Memory. Persistent memory is a fundamental open problem at the heart of AI. Our vision is to build models of human memory, and to endow humans with perfect and infinite memory.

Before starting Engramme, the founding team has produced and commercialized extensive research in machine learning and neuro-science inspired memory models:



- Gabriel Kreiman (CEO & Co-founder): Professor of Neuroscience and AI, Harvard Medical School. Led key research on brain memory consolidation at Harvard University. 
- Spandan Madan (CTO & Co-founder): PhD in Computer Science from Harvard, designed AI models which were commercially deployed at Adobe, Fujitsu, and Meta. 

What You’ll Do



- Build automated eval pipelines for memory retrieval, compression, and reconstruction. 
- Design benchmarks for context retention, long-term consistency, and memory safety. 
- Analyze model behavior, surface failure modes, and define quality metrics. 
- Run large-scale experiments and maintain continuous evaluation systems. 
- Develop internal tools, dashboards, and workflows for fast debugging. 
- Integrate evals directly into production with backend + research teams. 

What We’re Looking For



- Strong Python + ML framework experience. 
- Background in eval pipelines, model testing, or benchmarking. 
- Understanding of LLMs, embeddings, or retrieval systems. 
- Ability to analyze failures, define metrics, and reason from first principles. 
- Comfortable moving fast and owning core architecture. 

Nice to Have



- Experience with vector DBs, similarity search, or interpretability. 
- Distributed systems or high-throughput pipeline experience. 
- Startup experience or ML tooling/open-source contributions. 
- Familiarity with monitoring/experiment-tracking tools.
fit_why: Strong Python/LLM/RAG overlap; lacks ML framework and eval-pipeline depth

role: Machine Learning Engineer Intern, AI & Robotics
jd:
Why RoboForce

RoboForce is an AI robotics company developing Physical AI–powered Robo-Labor for dull, dirty, and dangerous work. The company’s robots are engineered for demanding industrial environments, with a focus on real-world deployment and scalability.

We are seeking a Machine Learning Engineer Intern to join us in developing advanced AI capabilities for robotics. The internship starts from November 2026 for 3-6 months. As part of our team, you will help build the foundational AI ecosystem, spanning data collection, labeling, training, evaluation, and deployment.

You will collaborate closely with a team of world-class AI engineers and gain hands-on experience solving real-world challenges at the intersection of artificial intelligence and robotics.

Responsibilities



- Train and improve robot foundation models, including vision-language-action (VLA) models and world-action models, for precise, contact-rich manipulation in industrial settings.
- Explore new modalities and methods, including tactile and force-torque sensing, reinforcement learning, and simulation, to advance model capabilities.
- Build data pipelines for robot learning, including data collection, curation, labeling, and dataset quality assurance.
- Design and run evaluations in simulation and on real robots to measure and improve model performance.
- Deploy models on robots and optimize them for real-time onboard inference.
- Work closely with robotics, hardware, and product teams to bring models from research to production.

Requirements



- Currently pursuing an advanced degree in Computer Science, Robotics, Machine Learning, or a related field, with a graduation date in 2026 or 2027.
- Proficiency in multimodal models, modern machine learning architectures (e.g., transformers and diffusion models), and reinforcement learning.
- Proficiency in deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch, JAX, or TensorFlow.
- Requires 5 days/week in-office collaboration with the teams.

Bonus Qualifications



- Exposure to robot learning using tactile and/or vision-based sensors.
- Expertise in object pose estimation, bimanual manipulation, and synthetic data.

Duration:



- 3–6 months, full-time

Compensation: 



- $5,000 - $6,500 monthly salary
fit_why: Robot foundation models, PyTorch/JAX, requires advanced degree and RL

Are you interested in applying data science to real business and product challenges? As a Data Science Intern at Resideo, you will work alongside data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to explore data, develop analytical solutions, and communicate actionable insights. You will gain hands-on experience with Python, SQL, and Databricks while supporting data preparation, visualization, and predictive modeling. With guidance from the team, you will complete a scoped project and present your findings and recommendations. Help create innovative technologies that make the world cleaner and more sustainable, more secure, connected, energy efficient, and productive.

Job Duties



-  Explore and analyze data to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities for business or product improvement.
-  Clean and prepare datasets, addressing missing values, inconsistencies, and data quality issues.
-  Write SQL queries and Python scripts in Databricks to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources.
-  Develop Databricks notebooks, dashboards and visualizations to communicate key findings and track performance metrics.
-  Support predictive modeling, including feature development, model training, and performance evaluation.
-  Analyze product usage and performance to understand customer behavior and identify opportunities for improvement.
-  Automate recurring analyses and reports to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
-  Collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders to translate business questions into analytical tasks.
-  Document datasets, methods, code, and findings using team standards and Git workflows.
-  Complete and present a scoped capstone project, explaining the approach, results, limitations, and recommended next steps.

You Must Have



-  Active student status pursuing a degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Engineering, or a related quantitative field.
-  Foundational experience with Python and SQL through coursework, academic projects, or internships.
-  Basic understanding of statistics, data analysis, and machine learning concepts.

We Value



-  Ability to communicate findings clearly, collaborate with others, and explain analytical work to technical and nontechnical audiences.
-  Experience cleaning, exploring, and visualizing data through coursework, research, or personal projects.
-  Familiarity with Databricks, Apache Spark, or cloud data platforms, and an interest in learning these tools.
-  Exposure to Python libraries such as pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, or Matplotlib, and to Git for version control.
-  Curiosity, attention to data quality, and the ability to break practical problems into manageable analytical tasks.
-  Willingness to learn from feedback, document work, and collaborate with data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders.

What's In It For You



-  Hands-on experience: Apply Python, SQL, and Databricks to real business and product data.
-  Mentorship and collaboration: Learn from experienced data scientists and engineers while contributing to meaningful projects.
-  Professional development: Build data science skills and present a capstone project with clear results, limitations, and recommendations.

jd:
Spring 2027 Internship: This position is located at our Frisco, TX location. Expected program dates are January 19 – April 23, 2027. Anticipated working hours will be 15-30 per week. Final hours and schedule will be determined between the intern and their manager.

Note: Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions will not be providing visa sponsorship for this position now or in the future. Therefore, in order to be considered for this position, you must have the ability to work without a need for current or future visa sponsorship.

Introduction

We are looking for a motivated, self-driven intern who is excited to build real software with the help of AI to join our engineering team supporting major retail customers.

Our team is helping these customers move from legacy store systems to a modern technology platform across several projects. The work includes upgrading the back-office web applications store teams use to run day-to-day operations, building new web interfaces for store services, and developing new in-store and mobile applications, from associate-facing tools to customer-facing experiences. AI will be at the center of this role, both in the features you build and in how you build them.

This is an ideal opportunity for a student who likes to take ownership, figure things out independently, and see their work used at scale in the real world.

What You’ll Work On



- Contribute to one of our new Spring 2027 retail projects, such as a new in-store application for store associates or a customer-facing mobile experience.
- Develop and prototype AI-powered features for new and existing retail applications, such as natural-language search, smart form validation, intelligent data entry, and automated data extraction.
- Use AI coding assistants such as Claude or Codex as a core part of your daily workflow to write, refactor, debug, and document code, and to ramp up quickly on unfamiliar codebases and technologies.
- Help build, maintain, and improve CI/CD pipelines, and find ways to bring AI into the build, test, and review process.
- Help modernize back-office web applications used to manage store data and day-to-day operations, using AI to understand and update existing code.
- Assist with building and enhancing user interfaces using Vue, and developing and updating the Java back-end services that power them.
- Support mobile and in-store device application development as new store technology moves from early development toward rollout.
- Collaborate with engineers and stakeholders to understand requirements, ask the right questions, and work independently to find solutions.

Required Qualifications



- Must be able to work on-site at our Frisco, TX location at least one day per week; two days in-person preferred.
- Currently pursuing a bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
- Understanding of AI coding tools such as Claude, Co-Pilot, or OpenAI
- Understanding of large language models (LLMs), including how they work, prompt engineering, and their strengths and limitations when building AI-powered applications.
- Programming knowledge in Java and/or JavaScript.
- Solid understanding of Vue.js or a similar front-end framework (React, Angular)
- Understanding of web application fundamentals (front end, back end, and how they connect through APIs).
- Ability to work independently, take ownership of tasks, and figure things out with minimal direction.
- Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and communication skills.
- Strong curiosity and willingness to learn new technologies quickly through hands-on work.

Preferred Qualifications



- Experience building Java back-end services or REST APIs.
- Familiarity with agentic AI, including AI agents that plan and carry out multi-step tasks.
- Understanding of Git, including branching, merging, and pull request workflows.
- Familiarity with the software development lifecycle (SDLC) and Agile practices.
- Experience writing unit, integration, or automated tests.
- Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and build or deployment tools.
- Interest in retail technology and point-of-sale systems.
